### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `UmbrellaElla.Flow.TitleToPlayToSurvived` (in `Tests/UI/`) passes, and its test-map row is set to merged with this card's number (final-9 A H6: the card whose lane holds the test owns it)
- [ ] `check_automation_report.py --require $(python3 tools/ui_check.py tests)` prints PASS for the P0 UI tests (pasted)
- [ ] `check_automation_report.py --require UmbrellaElla.Flow.World.MenuBlocksGameplayInput` prints PASS (pasted); the TD reviews it
